clause_title: Enhanced quarterly reporting with loan-level data tape
notes: Tape delivered via the data room within 60 days of quarter-end; same timing as the granting LP.

clause_title: ILPA fee and expense reporting template
notes: Quarterly; reconciles to Class A-D Management Fee rates (Annex C Section 3.1).

clause_title: Monthly FX hedge mark-to-market report
notes: Electable only by LPs holding a non-USD Commitment on the Cayman Feeder (Section 2.2).

clause_title: Disclosure of fund information to the LP's own regulators and auditors
notes: Generic carve-out; distinct from public-records disclosure (SLC-14).

clause_title: Transfer to Affiliates without General Partner consent
notes: Transferee must belong to the same Affiliated Investor Group (Section 1.3).

clause_title: Annual ESG and climate-risk questionnaire response
notes: One questionnaire per LP per fiscal year.

clause_title: Key person event notice within 5 business days
notes: Standard LPA notice period is 10 business days.

clause_title: Excuse right for investments contrary to a written investment policy
notes: Conditional: electing LP must deliver its own written policy of equivalent scope (Section 4.2 conditions travel with the clause).

clause_title: Successor fund capacity reservation
notes: Capacity capped at the electing LP's own Commitment to this fund.

clause_title: Advisory Committee seat or observer right
notes: Appointed by the General Partner; never electable at any tier.

clause_title: Co-investment allocation rights (no fee / no carry)
notes: Allocated deal by deal under the co-investment policy.

clause_title: Seed Investor Management Fee reduction (25 bps for fund life)
notes: Outside the Fee Tier schedule; Fee Tier comes only from fx_mfn_tier_rules.json.

clause_title: Initial Closing fee discount (10 bps for first 24 months)
notes: Applies only to LPs admitted at the 2026-02-06 Initial Closing.

clause_title: Public records / freedom of information disclosure carve-out
notes: Granted to US public pension plans subject to state public-records laws.

clause_title: ERISA plan-asset covenants and withdrawal right
notes: Benefit-plan investor specific.

clause_title: UBTI minimization covenant
notes: US tax-exempt LPs investing through the Cayman Feeder.

clause_title: Placement agent and pay-to-play representations
notes: State and municipal pension plan specific.

clause_title: Sovereign immunity reservation
notes: Granted to a sovereign wealth fund LP by reason of its status.

clause_title: Management Fee waiver for General Partner affiliates and employees
notes: Employee and affiliate feeder interests only.

clause_title: LP home-jurisdiction governing law and forum for side letter disputes
notes: Partnership Agreements remain governed by Cayman Islands and Delaware law.
